items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: Carson played for me...with me a long time.

ctx.x: Oh. Let's see. Personnel: Ernest Coycault, trumpet; Leon White, trombone; James "Jazz" Carson, tenor saxophone.

Oh, yeah, Carson. Carson played for me...with me a long time. He went to China with a group, and he married a Chinee woman over there, and he...when the war broke out, they came back, and he's got five or six little old Chinee babies.
